bibl.title: The Seal of the Living God: A Christian Amulet in the Chester Beatty Library.
bibl.seg: Yvona Trnka-Amrhein, The Seal of the Living God: A Christian Amulet in the Chester Beatty Library.
bibl.note: Provenance unknown, fourth century CE. - Description of the Papyrus [oὐροβόρος surrounding an open bookroll filled with an eight-by-eight square grid of Greek vowels]. - Place within the Magical Tradition. - Resurrection through Baptism: Distilling the Power of the Seal for Daily Life.
